Text: I had the chance to learn from Asma at MERAKI, and honestly, she made a big difference for me.  She explains things in a very simple way and is always there to help. What I really appreciated is how she encourages us to "just try". I’ll always remember her saying, “Just try… what’s the worst that could happen?”  That mindset helped me a lot in building confidence and keeping going.  I’m really thankful I learned from her.
